name: No Placement Delay
description: Removes the vanilla 4 tick right-click cooldown (Minecraft#rightClickDelay) that limits how fast you can place blocks (and use items) while holding the use button. Configurable delay and on/off. Client-side only. Supports Minecraft 26.1-26.3 and 1.21-1.21.11. Localized into 14 languages.
